C0617.title: Nearly 10 Billion Yuan Involved: China's First Illegal Cash-Out Case Using Merchant QR Codes Cracked, 21 Arrested
C0617.summary: Yangzhou police cracked the nation's first illegal cash-out case using merchant QR codes. Suspects exploited a bank policy waiving handling fees for merchant collection codes, registered numerous merchant QR codes, and conducted repeated fake transactions to swipe cards, obtaining bank cashback rewards and points.
